text:
sylvie_sales: Heads-up 50k ARR prospect (EU payroll) wants a 7-day EU-only POC to validate routing + key locality. they explicitly won't buy Dedicated yet. can we scope this?
noah_se: short: yes, we can run a timeboxed hosted POC with strong operational controls. Hosted provides tenant region affinity but not a contractual "no egress" guarantee. we'll produce artifacts to demonstrate flows.
tara_ops: ops plan: 1) create manual routing policy pinning tenant -> eu-west-1 for 7 days; 2) disable automatic cross-region fallback for the window; 3) enable netflow capture + KMS audit mode; 4) export logs and a processing-path diagram at POC end. needs on-call approval.
sylvie_sales: great. procurement will ask for a template header and what evidence they'll get.
noah_se: sample steer header to show them:```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}
x-tenant-id: payr-prospect
x-region-hint: eu-west-1
```
This steers requests to EU capacity; we will also tag tenant routing server-side for the POC.
ira_compliance: compliance note: we can provide netflow CSV, KMS region audit CSV for the scoped key, and a diagram. we cannot warrant cryptographic key residency in Hosted; for that they'd need BYOK in Dedicated/Private. i'll prepare a short RFP paragraph and a sub-processor annex for EU-only vendors.
tara_ops: timeline: can schedule the scoped policy in 4 business days if sales gets written approval from customer (scope + 7-day window). it's manual; ops ticket and on-call signoff required. we'll automatically revert policy at end of window unless customer requests extension.
sylvie_sales: cost/sla ask: what if they later convert to Dedicated for legal guarantees?
noah_se: quick guidance: Dedicated provisioning ~4-6 weeks; cost typically 2x-5x hosted unit rates depending on commit and model. offer a short "regional reservation" as a middle ground if capacity available.
ops-bot: ticket RD-POC-941 created, owners @tara_ops and @noah_se, requested start in 4 business days.
sylvie_sales: perfect. i'll upload the customer's questionnaire here once they send it and tag @ira_compliance. thanks team :thumbsup:
